_comment: Edits authors made in Document Authoring that a re-import must not undo. da-upload.mjs (also in the import loop) applies 'replace' ([from, to] literal strings) to the imported document before it uploads it; if a 'from' is no longer in the import and its 'to' is not there either, the document is not uploaded (problem reported). 'skip': true never uploads the document (author owns it completely). Add every DA edit here before the next upload.
